fees.source: ReserveAmerica price block on the dated site page(s) (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/loyalsock/camping ('may be reserved up to eleven months in advance'; 'Stays are limited to seven nights'; 'Check in and check out time is 3:00 P.M. note: Two gravel back-in sites about 360 m apart in the woods on Bear Wallow Road: 426 is 2.7 miles from Mill Creek Road (3.9 miles up from PA 87 near Hillsgrove), 418 a little farther along; the agency also gives a way in to 418 from Elk Creek Road by Hoagland Branch Road and Dry Run Township Road. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs. Its campsite map layer calls 426 tent-only with no trailer access, though the booking page sells it as an RV and trailer site (37 by 26 ft, 15 ft of overhead clearance); 418 is the larger, 65 by 38 ft. No toilet at the sites. Pack out trash. --Claude
